description.dum: Ruusbroecs verduidelijking van de eenheid met God, geschreven om valse mystiek te weerleggen (ook 'Boecsken der verclaringhe'). Middelnederlandse tekst van J. B. David (1868).
description.en-US: Ruusbroec's clarification of union with God, written against false mysticism (also called the Little Book of Enlightenment). The Middle Dutch text of J. B. David (1868). The English is C. A. Wynschenk Dom (1916), chapter for chapter.
description.pt-BR: Esclarecimento de Ruusbroec sobre a união com Deus, escrito contra a falsa mística (também chamado Livrinho de Esclarecimento). Texto em neerlandês médio de J. B. David (1868).

sources.edition: Jan van Ruusbroec, Werken, ed. J. B. David, deel 6: Hier deghint dat boec der hoechster waerheit. (Gent: Maetschappy der Vlaemsche Bibliophilen, 1868).
sources.description: Keyed text from DBNL (TEI XML, 'auteursrechtvrij'), converted by research/sourcing/_scripts/rhineland/ruus_build.py. Line-end hyphens joined; page and line breaks dropped. David's apparatus is kept as footnotes (manuscript variants F, G, I, L, M, D, Surius' Latin readings 'Sur.'). David's Dutch preface, manuscript list, misprint list and glossary are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Nineteenth-century critical edition, marked 'Auteursrechtvrij' on DBNL.

sources.edition: John of Ruysbroeck, The Adornment of the Spiritual Marriage; The Sparkling Stone; The Book of Supreme Truth, translated from the Flemish by C. A. Wynschenk Dom, with an introduction and notes by Evelyn Underhill (London: J. M. Dent, 1916).
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org scan, rejoined across lines and pages by research/sourcing/_scripts/wyn_build.py; running heads removed; Underhill's endnotes placed as footnotes at the passage that cites them. Not proofread against the page images.
